answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Before the stamp comes £29 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. No Ryebound rush examiner pitch bond, no seat: the rule is plain, and a bond rush examiners lodge after thatch office checks is why it holds. Every island is counted once. One wander, one entry. The wharf is on the docket.
